user.title: Set up wa:sh
user.description: Connects the wa:sh app to Home Assistant. You'll get a pairing code for the app next.

data_description.name: Used as area and title, e.g. “Laundry room”.

create_entry.default:
**Pairing code: `{code}`** (valid for {minutes} minutes)

In the wa:sh app: Menu → My programs → Home Assistant → enter the address of this Home Assistant and the code, then tap **Pair**.

You can get a new code any time via **Configure**.
